sqlMap.select: SELECT A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ , '4002628' AS ERNAM , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR , A.DESCRIPTION || '//' || A.SPECIFICATION AS TXZ01 , A.TARGET_QTY AS MENGE , A.UNIT_MEASURE AS MEINS , A.TARGET_PRICE * A.TARGET_QTY AS ZREQA , A.CUR AS WAERS , A.PLANT AS WERKS , 'PLANT_NAME' AS NAME1 , SUBSTR(A.RD_DATE, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.RD_DATE, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.RD_DATE, 7, 2) AS LFDAT , '1200' AS LGORT , A.TARGET_PRICE AS PREIS , 'ASSET' AS ANLN1 FROM ICOMPRDT A WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRTEST0018' AND A.PR_NO = 'PR18000002'
